description: [Approved mode — write] This tool creates a record in Pushizo. It only creates a DRAFT and never sends or schedules a message; the API key needs the `mcp:write` scope. Get explicit approval from the user before calling it. Creates a website pop-up, banner or slide-in as `draft`; does not publish it. Example: display {"layout":"popup","blocks":[{"type":"title","text":{"en":"Join our newsletter"}},{"type":"button","id":"close","text":{"en":"Later"},"action":{"type":"dismiss"}}]}, trigger {"kind":"page_load"} (others: scroll_depth, exit_intent, time_on_page; see list_web_campaigns output).

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

display.description: Display: layout (popup, banner_top, banner_bottom, slide_in, fullscreen) + blocks (get_web_campaign `display` format).

targeting.description: Visitor, device and segment targeting (get_web_campaign `targeting` format).

trigger.description: When to show it, e.g. {"kind":"page_load"} or {"kind":"scroll_depth","percent":50}.

name: create_web_campaign_draft
title: Create web campaign draft
